findings.detail: registry canonical root/current coordinator/not retired/memory status; active board task id, owner coordinator and executable ASSIGNED/IN_PROGRESS validated. Supplied session ID is an asserted identity checked against registry, not an independent runtime identity attestation; actual root invocation evidence required for final acceptance.
Absolute assigned source matches resolved path; exact 40-char base SHA must be ancestor; non-main assigned branch required; existing memory-role checker invoked on source snapshot.

Resolved coordination roots and output paths stay inside authorized roots; all policy/config/receipt relatives must be task allow_paths. Different existing policy/config or receipt hashes rejected; identical files retained; hard-link creation fails on existing destination. Partial creation reports created/unconfirmed without rollback/deletion of target.

Feedback triggers existing coordinator; idle waits without daemon/polling. No model selection/global config/business mutation/dispatch/deploy command in installer. Policy preserves non-author acceptance, exact-SHA gates, sole release owner and independent project limits.

Installer config+receipt explicitly POLICY_INSTALLED_PENDING_COORDINATOR_ACK; policy installation alone does not prove ACK or operational feedback loop. Final review requires root dry-run/apply/ACK and exact installed-file hashes.

limitations: No external installer execution or bridge read/execution; no behavioral tests
Root dry-run/apply/ACK receipts not supplied at review snapshot; final independent acceptance NOT_RUN
Static path protections do not constitute adversarial concurrent filesystem security guarantee; scope is current trusted task workflow
nextAction: Wait root explicit installed+ACK evidence notification; then final read-only independent review
